name: Frankfort (Kentucky, United States)
description: Indigo field with a light blue wave fimbriated in white flowing from the hoist to the fly, charged with an outlined golden star in the fly.
history: Frankfort is the capital city of Kentucky. The design was chosen by citizens through the Frankfort Flag Initiative and enacted by Ordinance No. 23, 2024 Series, given final adoption on 9 December 2024; its colours are taken from the former city flag adopted in 1959.

features.role: wave fimbriated in white, for the Kentucky River
